Mehedi Islam Rafi · Selected Watercolour Works · 2026

Life Between River and Hills

A series exploring landscape, everyday life and cultural memory within the riverine and hill environments of Bangladesh, where boats, bamboo structures, village paths and human movement become records of place and lived experience.

5 Works · Watercolour & Ink on Paper · Bangladesh · Listed Value USD 3,550
01

Crossing the Hills

2026Watercolour & Ink on Paper38.1 × 55.9 cm / 15 × 22 in

A bamboo bridge connects two sides of a hill settlement as villagers move across the stream below. The work reflects everyday movement, vernacular structures and the relationship between community and landscape.

02

Sangu Journey

2026Watercolour & Ink on Paper38.1 × 55.9 cm / 15 × 22 in

Wooden boats move quietly through the river as layered hills rise beyond the water. The painting explores the river as a space of travel, livelihood and cultural memory within the landscape of Bandarban.

USD 75002_Sangu_Journey_2026.jpg
03

Morning in the Hills

2026Watercolour & Ink on Paper38.1 × 55.9 cm / 15 × 22 in

A hillside settlement emerges through layers of vegetation, distant mountains and morning atmosphere. Small human figures and vernacular houses bring everyday life into dialogue with the surrounding landscape.

04

Hill Village

2026Watercolour & Ink on Paper38.1 × 55.9 cm / 15 × 22 in

Bamboo houses, winding paths and tropical vegetation follow the contours of a mountain settlement. The work considers how architecture, geography and daily movement collectively shape a sense of place.

USD 70004_Hill_Village_2026.jpg
05

Riverbank Stories

2026Watercolour & Ink on Paper38.1 × 55.9 cm / 15 × 22 in

Traditional boats gather beside a modest riverside settlement while figures move between land and water. Loose lines and transparent washes evoke the rhythms of river life and the relationship between people, boats and place.
